# JFR test files (issue #819)

Recordings and expected outputs from the JFR parser library the profiles
reference depends on, tag `v0.19.0` (commit `9ca50a88`), directory
`parser/testdata/`, under that library's licence, Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE`
here, unchanged). The expected outputs were produced by the library's own
code; nothing here is generated by PulsusDB.

| File here | Original name |
|---|---|
| `example.jfr.gz` | `example.jfr.gz` |
| `example.cpu.txt.gz` | `example_3_process_cpu_cpu__nanoseconds_expected_collapsed.txt.gz` |
| `example.alloc_in.txt.gz` | `example_0_memory_alloc_in_new_tlab_objects__count alloc_in_new_tlab_bytes__bytes_expected_collapsed.txt.gz` |
| `example.alloc_out.txt.gz` | `example_1_memory_alloc_outside_tlab_objects__count alloc_outside_tlab_bytes__bytes_expected_collapsed.txt.gz` |
| `example.mutex.txt.gz` | `example_2_mutex_contentions__count delay__nanoseconds_expected_collapsed.txt.gz` |
| `dump1.jfr.gz` | `dump1.jfr.gz` |
| `dump1.labels.pb.gz` | `dump1.labels.pb.gz` |
| `dump1.cpu.txt.gz` | `dump1_0_process_cpu_cpu__nanoseconds_expected_collapsed.txt.gz` |
| `wall.jfr.gz` | `wall.jfr.gz` |
| `wall.cpu.txt.gz` | `wall_0_process_cpu_cpu__nanoseconds_expected_collapsed.txt.gz` |
| `wall.wall.txt.gz` | `wall_1_wall_wall__nanoseconds_expected_collapsed.txt.gz` |

`example.mutex.txt.gz` holds the library's delay in clock ticks; PulsusDB
stores nanoseconds (`docs/reference-defects-we-do-not-copy.md` entry 47),
so its test compares the counts exactly and the delays after conversion.
